meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求搜 X(原 Twitter)上的内容时,Claude 会先检查对应工具是否可用,不可用就改用普通网页搜索并说明;可用时,它会按日期、账号和关键词把请求拆成两三次小搜索,在结果中附上原帖链接并标明是 X 帖子,还会与网页搜索结果相互印证。
howto.when: 在连接了 xAI 账户的情况下,当你想搜 X 或 Twitter 上的帖子,或提到“x_search”、“social signal”等词时触发。

say.text: 搜一下 X 上关于英伟达最近三天的新帖。
say.note: Claude 会限定日期并拆成小搜索。

say.text: 查一下 @growth_papa 最近在 X 上发的关于市场的帖子。
say.note: Claude 会按可信账号搜索。

say.text: 看看 X 上大家对苹果新发布的反应,只要带链接的帖子。
say.note: Claude 会过滤回复并只取带链接的帖子。

howto.what_en: When you ask to search X/Twitter, Claude checks the X search tool; if missing, falls back to web search. If present, it splits into 2-3 scoped searches by date/account/keyword, cites x.com links as X posts, and cross-checks with web results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to search X/Twitter posts, or say 'x_search'/'social signal', with an xAI account connected.

say_en.text: Search X for NVIDIA posts from the last 3 days.
say_en.note: Claude date-bounds and splits the search.

say_en.text: See what @growth_papa posted on X lately about markets.
say_en.note: Claude treats the handle as trusted.

say_en.text: Find reactions to Apple's new release on X, with links only.
say_en.note: Claude drops replies and keeps link posts.
